name: Raxio UG1 data centre (Namanve)
developer: Raxio Group / Raxio Data Centre Ltd
notes: Operator page confirms enterprise-grade carrier/cloud-neutral data centre in Namanve Industrial Park (KIBP), 15 km from Kampala CBD; launched May 2021 (Watchdog) as Uganda's first Uptime Tier III design-certified data centre, ~1,542 sqm, up to 400 racks and 1.5 MW IT power per operator release (capacity A/B as operator claim). 2026-08-07 TechAfrica News: Raxio appointed a new Uganda GM, confirming active 2026 operation; Observer reported the government-backed ABQ Cloud launched inside the Raxio Namanve facility.

name: MTN Uganda data centre network (Mutundwe and regional sites)
notes: MTN Uganda official page describes its data-centre services and states MTN operates the largest commercial data-centre footprint in Uganda: 6 data centres spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions with total capacity of 972 racks. Methodology pass confirms the Mutundwe switch/data centre was commissioned in 2012 and houses MTN data servers. Exact addresses of the regional sites are not disclosed on the page.

name: MTN Mbuya Data Centre (Kampala)
notes: Directory record (Data Center Map) places an MTN Business data centre at Plot 2310, Togo House, 12 Port Bell Rd, Mbuya, Kampala. MTN's official data-centre services page corroborates MTN's DC service portfolio but does not name the Mbuya facility, so the specific named site remains C-level pending primary confirmation.

name: NITA-U National Data Centre (NDC)
notes: Government NDC page confirms operational government hosting infrastructure with IaaS/PaaS/managed services and a 99.98% SLA claim. Exact physical location/address is not publicly disclosed, so precise site is U; service existence is A.

name: NITA-U Third National Data Centre (market study)
notes: Official 2025 data-centre market-study/watchlist item to guide expansion toward a Third National Data Centre; per methodology this is a study/planning signal, not a built facility. Location and capacity undetermined.

name: UiXP peering facilities (Communications House and Raxio Namanve)
notes: UiXP official contact page confirms two peering facilities: Communications House, 1 Colville Street, Kampala, and Raxio Data Center, Plot 781 Block 113, Namanve Industrial Park; PeeringDB IX 422 corroborates. IXP/peering infrastructure, not a standalone commercial colocation DC unless separately evidenced.

name: Roke Telkom / Roke Cloud data-centre services (Kulubya Close)
notes: Operator pages market IT/data-centre services, hosting and cloud (service claim A); a physical Roke data centre at Kulubya Close is claimed in directory/social listings but not clearly published on operator pages reviewed, so the named facility record is C/U pending a primary source.

name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Uganda - Azure Stack local cloud
notes: Liquid's official Uganda office/service presence is A; DCD reported Liquid launched Microsoft Azure Stack in Uganda in 2024 (B-grade local cloud signal). Physical hosting facility location in Uganda is unresolved (U), so this is a service/local-cloud record, not a verified facility.

name: Baasa Cloud hosting (Naguru)
notes: Local hosting/cloud provider; social/directory listings give 1 Water Lane, Naguru. No primary facility page found stating data-centre details, so facility record is C/U. Hostalite, Computer Point, Datanet and CSG similarly remain hosting-service leads without facility evidence.

name: MTN Uganda regional data centre (Eastern region)
notes: MTN Uganda official page states its 6 data centres are spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions (total 972 racks), which is direct operator evidence of data-centre presence in the Eastern region. The specific town/campus is not disclosed. No independent commercial colocation facility (Raxio-style) verified in Eastern; other hits were NBI fibre, telco exchanges and service centres, which are not DC evidence.

No datacenter facility found for the Northern region in 2026-08-12 searches (Gulu, Lira, Arua, Moroto, Karamoja, West Nile). Verified signals are NITA-U NBI Phase V/Moroto connectivity expansion and district/telco infrastructure, which per methodology are connectivity evidence, not datacenter records. No hosting/colo/cloud facility confirmed.

name: MTN Uganda regional data centre (Western region)
notes: MTN Uganda official page states its 6 data centres are spread across Central, Eastern, Western and Southern regions (total 972 racks), providing operator evidence of data-centre presence in the Western region; specific town/campus not disclosed. Otherwise Western hits (Mbarara, Hoima, oil/gas, bank DR) are watchlist signals; no independent commercial colocation facility verified.
